description: This file contains unit tests for the DeepLinkParser component, which interprets custom URL schemes related to OpenClaw application links, including agent and gateway links. It tests URL parsing logic, validation, and decoding from setup codes.

classes.name: DeepLinkParserTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the parsing and validation logic of deep links within the OpenClaw application.

methods.name: parseRejectsUnknownHost
methods.description: Tests that URLs with unknown hosts are rejected by the parser.

methods.name: parseHostIsCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Verifies that the host part of the URL parsing is case-insensitive.

methods.name: parseRejectsNonOpenClawScheme
methods.description: Checks that URLs not using the 'openclaw' scheme are rejected.

methods.name: parseRejectsEmptyMessage
methods.description: Tests that messages with only whitespace are rejected.

methods.name: parseAgentLinkParsesCommonFields
methods.description: Verifies that agent URLs with common fields are correctly parsed into agent actions.

methods.name: parseAgentLinkParsesTargetRoutingFields
methods.description: Tests parsing of target routing fields such as 'to', 'channel', and 'key' in agent URLs.

methods.name: parseRejectsNegativeTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Ensures negative timeout seconds are ignored or cause rejection.

methods.name: parseGatewayLinkParsesCommonFields
methods.description: Verifies correct parsing of gateway URLs with host, port, tls, token, and password.

methods.name: parseGatewayLinkRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that non-secure WebSocket connections to non-loopback addresses are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayLinkRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Verifies that URLs with insecure hosts matching bypass patterns are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewaySetupCodeParsesBase64UrlPayload
methods.description: Tests decoding of setup code payloads containing gateway connection info.

methods.name: parseGatewaySetupCodeRejectsInvalidInput
methods.description: Ensures invalid setup codes are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewaySetupCodeDefaultsTo443ForWssWithoutPort
methods.description: Checks that default port 443 is used for secure WebSocket URLs without an explicit port.

methods.name: parseGatewaySetupCodeRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Verifies rejection of insecure WebSocket URLs to non-loopback addresses.

methods.name: parseGatewaySetupCodeRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Ensures that insecure hosts matching bypass patterns are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewaySetupCodeAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Verifies that loopback WebSocket URLs are accepted, even if insecure.
